title: High CPU Usage
troubleshooting_steps: Check CPU usage for individual processes
Restart a service only if approved and necessary

title: High Memory Usage
troubleshooting_steps: Review application logs for memory errors
Check whether memory usage increases over time
Escalate the incident if memory usage remains critical

title: Server Is Not Running
troubleshooting_steps: Verify the server status in the monitoring system
Review recent shutdown or maintenance events
Restart the server only after checking the cause and obtaining authorization
